svg.title: Arrow — layer asset for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Bold downward arrow, free-standing on a transparent background, 1024×1024. Horizontally centred (x = 512), vertically from y = 210 to y = 830. Shaft 180 wide, head 380 wide. Corners slightly rounded (r ≈ 20) so the shape does not read as sharp-edged under the glass treatment. The gradient is deliberately subtle — it only suggests a direction; the depth comes from Icon Composer.
